runtimeAndEffects.sourceMode: All original files, criteria, setup, guards and deadlines remain byte exact. No adapter, compiler/build or dist mutation is introduced. The current launcher fingerprint is Node v22.23.3/ABI 127; original workers and the image child do not print direct ABI observations.
runtimeAndEffects.mechanisms: The corpus combines actual crypto, local files and unlink with original explicit admission and node:fs fault controls, canned provider transport and in-process Commander. It is not mock-free, actual provider measurement or installed CLI evidence.
runtimeAndEffects.ciphertext: Lifecycle/CLI ciphertext uses a known synthetic key distinct from workspace decryption material. Ciphertext integrity and not-decrypted/plaintextVerified=false flags do not establish plaintext decryption.
runtimeAndEffects.childAndTar: The retained source keeps the actual attachment Node/tsx image child and bundle tar calls. The child is a fresh reader after writer.close, but normal writer closure can retain a parent pool; same-process coldRows is not a cold process. Bundle cases retain 60-second deadlines, tar 10-second calls and child 30 seconds/32 MiB, alongside ordinary 30-second cases.
runtimeAndEffects.filesystemBoundary: CLI snapshots exclude WAL/SHM. Original cleanup and observed assertions do not establish universal physical-close/no-effects intervals, concurrent confinement or a repaired prior P0-27 pooled-parent corruption cause.
runtimeAndEffects.trustAndErasure: Local signed fixture rows and workspace-consistency monitor trust are not independent external person/agent truth or full history completeness. Local erasure can remain partial when final audit fails after unlink; it does not cover remote copies/backups or all-or-nothing cross-store deletion.
